meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁撰写公司内部沟通文档。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal communications using company-approved formats.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write internal company communications.

howto.what: 写内部沟通时,Claude 会先判断类型,再从 examples/ 目录加载对应指南文件(如 3p-updates.md、company-newsletter.md 等),按其中的格式、语气和内容要求来产出。若类型不匹配任何指南,它会先向你确认格式或补充背景。
howto.when: 当你要求写内部沟通时接管,例如 3P 更新、公司简报、FAQ 回复等;类型不匹配现有指南时,它会先询问更多格式信息。

say.text: 帮我写一份这周的 3P 更新
写一封面向全公司的简报,讲讲本月进展
帮我把这些常见问题整理成 FAQ 回复

howto.what_en: For internal communications, Claude first identifies the type, then loads the matching guideline file from the examples/ directory (e.g. 3p-updates.md, company-newsletter.md) and follows its format, tone and content rules. If no guideline matches, it asks about the desired format.
howto.when_en: Use it whenever you ask for an internal communication, such as 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ responses, etc. If the type matches no guideline, it asks for more format details first.

say_en.text: Write my 3P update for this week
Draft a company newsletter on this month's progress
Turn these common questions into FAQ answers
